title: Fix stage probe stream metadata when tags are absent
summary: Make the probe stage tolerate ffprobe stream objects that omit optional tags or disposition data so audio and subtitle tracks still reach queue file override metadata.
reason: Some valid Matroska files report video streams without a tags object. The probe stage treated that optional missing object as a stream JSON failure and returned an empty streams array, so the WebView showed zero detected audio/subtitle tracks.
behavior_before: A stream with no tags object could abort ConvertTo-StreamSummary, leaving ProbeResult.streams empty even when ffprobe reported audio and subtitle streams.
behavior_after: Missing stream tags or disposition values default to blank/false values, and the rest of the stream list is preserved for downstream track metadata.
manual_validation: Direct ffprobe on Ranma UNC sample with bundled ffprobe - passed; reported 2 audio streams and 1 subtitle stream.
_probe_tracks_for_source_path on Ranma UNC sample - passed; payload has 2 audio_tracks and 1 subtitle_track.
run_probe_stage on Ranma UNC sample - passed; ProbeResult.streams contains video, 2 audio, 1 subtitle and probe_error is blank.
rollback_plan: Revert ops/pipeline/engine/probe/stage.ps1 and regenerate its summary. The queue file override drawer would again rely on the previous stream-summary behavior.
notes:
Fix stage probe stream-summary parsing when ffprobe stream objects omit tags/disposition, which caused audio/subtitle tracks to disappear from queue file overrides.
Completed after direct Ranma UNC probe verification plus focused stage and file-override tests.
